record.body:
## Interfaces

Landed orchestra.composer with schemas/composer.json (namespace composer, 1.0.0; area and idea types), pyproject package, package-data and canon.schemas entry point, and composer.json added to the test schema paths.

## Assumptions

R15 and R16 are evaluated against the primary checkout's live store, not the worktree's tracked .canon copy.

## Invariants

score.json, conductor.json and tuner.json are unchanged. composer imports only canon and score; the boundary test rejects composer importing conductor.

## Conflicts

None. The worktree .canon/config.json differs from the primary one by design.
